shared.dbConnectionHint: Check the database connection for the System Configuration module.
shared.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Cannot be changed once created.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: The default appearance for this instance. A user can override it with their own choice in the header.
appearance.noneDescription: Every user keeps their own choice; new users see the default appearance.
appearance.loadFailedBody: Try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, contact your administrator.
appearance.unknownPresetBody: The stored value “{{value}}” does not match any preset in this version of the application. The instance behaves as if nothing was set. Saving anything below overwrites it.
appearance.saveFailed: Could not save the instance appearance

users.title: Users
users.description: Identities and the roles assigned to them. Permissions come from roles; they are never granted to a user directly.
users.emptyDescription: Users appear after their first sign-in, or after the bootstrap seed is run.
users.noRolesDefined: No roles have been defined yet.

form.emailHint: This is pre-provisioning only — a row with an email address so a role can be granted before that person signs in. Authentication runs through oauth2-proxy, not a password.
form.emailLockedHint: The identity cannot be edited — a different email address is a different user.

errors.detailsSaveFailed: Could not save the user details

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles are the only carrier of permissions. A system role is protected from deletion.
roles.emptyDescription: Run the bootstrap seed to create the administrator role.
roles.systemProtectedTooltip: A system role is protected from deletion
roles.deleteConfirmBody: Deleting the role also removes all of its grants to applications and scopes, and every user assignment to it. This cannot be undone.

openwebui.notConfigured: OpenWebUI synchronisation is not configured on this instance (OPENWEBUI_URL/OPENWEBUI_ADMIN_TOKEN).
openwebui.notMapped: This role is not linked to any OpenWebUI group.
openwebui.attachConfirmBody: At the next synchronisation this group's membership will be OVERWRITTEN to match this role. If the group gates access to another assistant in OpenWebUI (through access_control), its availability to users may change unexpectedly. Make sure this is the right group.
openwebui.previewSummary: At the next synchronisation: {{toAdd}} added, {{toRemove}} removed (target: {{target}} active users with an OpenWebUI account).

toast.groupCreated: Created an OpenWebUI group for role {{name}}
toast.detached: Unlinked the OpenWebUI group from the role — its membership in OpenWebUI is left untouched

errors.createFailed: Could not create the OpenWebUI group
errors.attachFailed: Could not link the OpenWebUI group
errors.detachFailed: Could not unlink the OpenWebUI group
errors.syncFailed: Could not synchronise the OpenWebUI group

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: The applications of this instance. An application code is also the entitlement code checked when entering the module.
applications.reorderHint: Reordering mode: the arrows move a row and save immediately. The order decides how tiles are laid out on the hub.
applications.emptyDescription: Add the first application. The hub still shows tiles hard-wired in code — an empty list switches nothing off.
applications.selfManagedTooltip: The System Configuration application cannot be disabled — it would cut administrators off

errors.reorderFailed: Could not save the new order
errors.reorderPartial: Could not save some of the changes ({{failed}}/{{total}}) — the order was refreshed from the database

form.noManifests: Nothing left to activate — every native module registered in code is already active on this instance.
form.manifestLockedHint: The code and the route come from the module's code — not editable, even after activation.
form.urlHint: Only http:// and https:// addresses are allowed.
form.routeHint: A route inside this application, starting with a single slash.
form.colorHint: The colour of the tile icon on the hub. With nothing chosen the tile gets a neutral default.
form.colorInertNotice: The “{{preset}}” appearance does not use this palette — hub tiles get one of that appearance's three accents, picked by functional category. Your choice is still saved and takes effect in appearances that do read the palette.
form.categoryDepartmentHint: You can pick several. Drives the “Departments” tab on the hub.
form.categoryFunctionalHint: A single value. Drives the “Functions” tab on the hub.
form.nativeLockedHint: Native tile — the type and the route are set solely by activating a registered manifest and cannot be changed here.
form.showOnHubHint: A switch separate from “Application active”: “active” decides the entitlement, this one only decides whether the tile renders on the hub. Turning it off takes access away from nobody — it only hides the card.
form.nextStepNative: You set the remaining fields and role permissions on the details page, right after activation.
form.nextStepExternal: You set the remaining fields and role permissions on the details page, right after creating it.

detail.notFoundDescription: Code {{code}} does not exist in the application registry.
detail.selfManagedTitle: This is the application you are using right now
detail.selfManagedBody: You cannot change the code, the type or the address of this application, nor disable or delete it. This code is what the gate checks for access to System Configuration, and the type and address describe this very module — such a change would either cut every administrator off from it (you included) or move administration outside this application, and it could only be undone by hand in the database. The server rejects these operations regardless of what the browser sends.
detail.basicsIntro: How the application is described in the instance registry.
detail.codeLockedHint: The code cannot be changed once the application exists.
detail.permissionsIntro: The roles that have access to this application. Permissions are granted to roles, not to users.
detail.noRolesForAccess: No roles have been defined yet, so there is nobody to grant access to.
detail.scopesIntro: Fine-grained permissions inside this application — specific actions, not access to the tile itself.
detail.noScopes: This application defines no fine-grained scopes. Scopes are created in the module's code, together with the section they protect — they cannot be added from this panel.
detail.noRolesForScopes: No roles have been defined yet, so there is nobody to grant a scope to.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: Deleting the application also removes every role grant to it. This cannot be undone.
detail.hideConfirmBody: This tile is visible on the home page today. Once saved it disappears from the hub of EVERY user who currently sees it — permissions (who has access) do not change, only the card stops rendering. The change becomes real only after you click “Save details”.

openwebui.title: OpenWebUI synchronisation
openwebui.description: Brings OpenWebUI accounts and groups in line with System Configuration. The preview writes nothing — only the button next to it applies the changes.
